content_sections.heading: Important Dates for Vikarabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must follow both the online application schedule and the separate document submission schedule. The dates mentioned in the official notice are given below. Important: Candidates should not confuse the last date for online applications with the document submission deadline. The online form must be submitted by 24 October 2026, while the specified document submission period runs from 26 October to 01 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Vikarabad Anganwadi Vacancy 2026: Project-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The notification announces 264 vacancies distributed across five projects in Vikarabad district. The largest number of posts is in the Pargi project, followed by Tandur. Pargi has the highest number of vacancies, with 105 posts, including 27 Anganwadi Teacher positions and 78 Anganwadi Helper positions. Tandur has 51 vacancies, Kodangal has 44, Marpally has 35, and Vikarabad has 29.

content_sections.heading: Vikarabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The newspaper notification directs applicants to the official Women Development and Child Welfare Department website for detailed eligibility information, including educational qualifications, age requirements, local eligibility conditions, selection procedure, and other recruitment rules. The post-specific educational requirements for Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Helper are to be verified from the detailed recruitment information on the official website. Applicants should not assume that both posts have identical qualification requirements. Applicants should review the detailed eligibility rules applicable to the project and post for which they intend to apply. The notification refers candidates to the department website for eligibility, local conditions, educational qualifications, and selection information.

content_sections.heading: Vikarabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates should check the detailed guidelines for the method of selection, required certificates, verification procedure, and any other conditions before submitting their applications.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Vikarabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online through the Telangana Women Development and Child Welfare Department website. The newspaper notification also requires a separate submission of attested documents after the online application period. Visit the official website at wdcw.tg.nic.in . Locate the Vikarabad district Anganwadi Teacher and Helper recruitment information. Read the detailed eligibility and application instructions carefully. Access the appropriate online application facility. Complete the form with accurate personal, educational, and other required information. Provide the documents and information requested by the application portal. Review the completed details before final submission. Submit the application by 24 October 2026, before 5:00 PM. Keep a copy of the submitted application for the subsequent document submission process. Note: The steps above are general guidance based on the prescribed online application method. Candidates must follow the actual instructions and fields displayed on the official portal.

content_sections.heading: Document Submission After Online Application
content_sections.text: According to the notification, applicants who have submitted their online applications must submit the required attested copies of their application and relevant documents at the concerned ICDS project office during the period from 26 October to 01 November 2026. The notification specifies submission to the concerned ICDS project office. Candidates should identify the relevant project office and follow the detailed departmental directions.

faq.question: Q1. What is Telangana Anganwadi (Vikarabad) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by the Women and Child Development Department Telangana for filling Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Aya posts in Vikarabad district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The notification mentions a total of 264 vacancies across Vikarabad district, with project-wise breakdowns listed in the notification text.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 24 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only female candidates meeting the local area, age, and qualification guidelines can apply.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the notification number?
faq.answer: The notification number is 164/A/DWO/VKB/2026, dated 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Where can candidates apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates should visit the official Telangana Women Development and Child Welfare Department website at wdcw.tg.nic.in and follow the recruitment application instructions.
